method: Three sequential fresh processes per mode/input at 144 DPI, five warm repetitions and every page; mode order alternated across repeats. No concurrent local validation/build processes. Input hashing precedes measurements and warms filesystem cache. Same build with native session kept versus explicitly closed before rendering.

runs.limitations: Synthetic or caller-selected input only. Input hashing precedes measurement and warms the filesystem cache. RSS includes native/global caches and allocator retention; peak RSS cannot decrease or prove close reclamation. Calls hold the Python GIL. No cross-format fidelity or throughput guarantee.
